selected.resolution: USB receiver was defective. Replaced with new mouse and receiver from inventory. Paired successfully. User confirmed mouse is tracking properly.

selected.subject: Database storage almost full
selected.description: hi, production database server is at 92% disk usage. growing about 2gb per day. if we don't do something we'll run out of space in about 2 weeks. i tried the usual troubleshooting steps. this is affecting my productivity but not a total blocker.
selected.resolution: Identified 180GB of orphaned temp tables and expired audit logs eligible for cleanup. Purged old data, compressed remaining tables, and implemented automated cleanup job. Storage dropped to 64%. Also requested additional storage for long-term growth.

selected.subject: Ransomware warning on screen
selected.description: hello, there's a scary message on my screen saying my files are encrypted and i need to pay bitcoin to get them back. i can't open any of my documents. help! it was working fine until last friday. i cleared my browser cache but it didn't help. no rush on this — just flagging it when you have time. regards.
selected.resolution: CRITICAL: Immediately isolated workstation from network. Confirmed ransomware infection contained to local drive only — network shares not affected. Wiped and reimaged machine. Restored user files from last night's backup. Incident reported to security team for full investigation.

selected.subject: Connection pool exhausted — app can't connect to DB
selected.description: our application is throwing 'connection pool exhausted' errors. users are getting timeout errors. we haven't changed any code recently. not super urgent but it's getting annoying. i asked a coworker and they don't have this problem. happy to work around this short-term but it needs to be addressed. let me know if you need more info.
selected.resolution: Found connection leak in recent application deployment — connections weren't being properly returned to the pool. Fixed the connection disposal in the app code and increased pool size from 50 to 100 as interim measure. Error resolved.

selected.subject: New service needs firewall exception
selected.description: hi it, we're deploying a new fortinet fortigate instance and need ports 443 and 8080 opened between the app server (10.0.5.20) and the database server (10.0.6.15). change request cr-4521 approved. i'm working remotely today if that matters. i checked and my internet connection seems fine. happy to work around this short-term but it needs to be addressed.
selected.resolution: Created firewall rules per CR-4521: allowed TCP/443 and TCP/8080 between specified hosts. Rules tested and verified. Notified requestor that the change is live.

selected.subject: Security training overdue for team
selected.description: hi, my entire team of 12 in operations is overdue on their annual security awareness training. can you send them the enrollment links? this can wait — just wanted to log it so it doesn't get forgotten.
selected.resolution: Sent enrollment invitations for security awareness training to all 12 team members with a completion deadline of 2 weeks. Set up automated reminders at 7-day and 3-day marks. Will report completion status to manager.

selected.subject: Laptop won't turn on
selected.description: my surface pro 9 won't power on at all. no lights, no fan, nothing happens when i press the power button. was working fine when i shut it down yesterday. other people on my team are seeing the same thing. this is slowing me down but i can work around it for now. appreciate the help.
selected.resolution: Performed hard reset by removing battery and holding power button for 30 seconds. Reseated RAM and power connection. Laptop powered on — diagnostics show battery was fully depleted due to BIOS update pending. Charged and verified stable.

selected.subject: Can't send emails — getting bounce back
selected.description: every email i try to send bounces back with an ndr saying 'message rejected by relay.' only started today — was sending fine yesterday. this is only happening on my machine. i checked and my internet connection seems fine. this is time-sensitive — please treat as high priority.
selected.resolution: User's sending limit had been triggered by an automated report that sent 500+ emails. Reset the sending quota and helped user configure the report to use a distribution list instead of individual addresses.

selected.subject: Application blocked by firewall
selected.description: good morning, i need to access palo alto globalprotect but i'm getting a connection refused error. i think the firewall might be blocking it. the vendor says we need to allow outbound traffic on port 8443. i tried the usual troubleshooting steps. this is slowing me down but i can work around it for now. cheers.
selected.resolution: Added firewall rule to allow outbound TCP/8443 to the vendor's IP range. Verified connectivity from user's workstation. Application now connects successfully.

selected.subject: Database login failing with authentication error
selected.description: hello support, i can't connect to the database anymore — getting 'login failed for user' error. my password hasn't changed and i was able to connect yesterday. please advise.
selected.resolution: User's database account had expired per the 90-day rotation policy. Reset database password and reminded user of the rotation schedule. Also set up a reminder notification 7 days before next expiration.

selected.subject: Password expired while on vacation
selected.description: was on vacation for 2 weeks and my password expired while i was away. can't log in to reset it because the old password doesn't work and the new one hasn't been set. i asked a coworker and they don't have this problem. no rush on this — just flagging it when you have time. please advise.
selected.resolution: Reset password via admin console. Extended password expiration policy for users on extended leave to prevent this issue. User logged in and set new permanent password.

selected.subject: CI/CD pipeline broken
selected.description: our jenkins pipeline has been failing for the past 3 builds. error is in the docker build step — image won't build. blocking all deployments to staging and production. not super urgent but it's getting annoying. i've already missed one meeting because of this. please help urgently.
selected.resolution: Docker build was failing because base image tag 'latest' had been updated upstream with breaking changes. Pinned base image to specific version tag, fixed the dependency that broke, and rebuilt. Pipeline green again.

selected.subject: Need additional monitor for dual setup
selected.description: good morning, i'd like to request a second monitor for my workstation. i work with spreadsheets and our hp zbook fury dashboard simultaneously and constantly switching between them is killing my productivity. manager ok'd it. happy to work around this short-term but it needs to be addressed. thank you.

selected.subject: Laptop keyboard keys not working
selected.description: several keys on my laptop keyboard stopped working — the e, r, and t keys specifically. makes it really hard to type. started after a small coffee spill last week that i cleaned up right away. other people on my team are seeing the same thing. i already tried restarting my computer. happy to work around this short-term but it needs to be addressed.

selected.subject: Browser crashing repeatedly
selected.description: hi there, chrome keeps crashing multiple times a day. sometimes individual tabs crash, sometimes the whole browser goes down. losing work in web apps when it happens. it was working fine until last friday. this is critical — customer-facing services are unavailable right now. thanks in advance.
selected.resolution: Found 3 conflicting browser extensions causing memory leaks. Disabled problematic extensions, cleared browser cache (was 4.2GB), and updated Chrome to latest version. Stable since fix.

selected.subject: Network slow only in the afternoon
selected.description: hi it, network speed is fine in the morning but after about 1pm it becomes nearly unusable. this pattern has been consistent for the past week. are we hitting bandwidth limits? i asked a coworker and they don't have this problem.
selected.resolution: Identified that automated backup jobs were scheduled at 12:30pm and consuming 80% of WAN bandwidth. Rescheduled backups to 11pm and implemented QoS policies to prioritize user traffic.

selected.subject: Database login failing with authentication error
selected.description: hi there, i can't connect to the database anymore — getting 'login failed for user' error. my password hasn't changed and i was able to connect yesterday. i tried the usual troubleshooting steps. production is down. all users affected. needs immediate escalation. cheers.

selected.subject: Jira crashes on startup
selected.description: jira crashes immediately when i try to open it. get a brief flash of the splash screen then it closes. no error message. was working fine until this morning. this has been going on for about a week now. this is affecting my productivity but not a total blocker.
selected.resolution: Corrupted user profile config file was causing crash on load. Renamed the config directory to force regeneration of defaults. Application now starts normally. User re-applied their preferences.

selected.subject: Database CPU at 100% during business hours
selected.description: hey team, the production database server is pegged at 100% cpu from about 9am to 5pm. everything slows to a crawl. only happens on weekdays. it's been like this since monday. i cleared my browser cache but it didn't help. this is a minor inconvenience, not urgent at all.

selected.subject: Calendar showing wrong time zone
selected.description: all my calendar events are showing up 3 hours off. a meeting at 10am shows at 1pm on my calendar. just got back from a business trip and it hasn't corrected itself. it was working fine until last friday. this is affecting my productivity but not a total blocker. thanks in advance.
selected.resolution: Outlook time zone was still set to the travel destination. Reset time zone to local in Outlook settings and Windows system settings. Calendar events now display at correct times.

selected.subject: Docking station not recognizing devices
selected.description: hey, my docking station stopped recognizing my external monitors and usb devices when i dock my laptop. was working fine last week. undocking and redocking doesn't help. it's been like this since monday. no rush on this — just flagging it when you have time. thank you.
selected.resolution: Docking station firmware was outdated and incompatible with recent laptop BIOS update. Updated dock firmware to latest version and power-cycled the dock. All peripherals now recognized correctly.

selected.subject: Outdated software with known vulnerabilities
selected.description: we're still running an old version of crowdstrike falcon that has multiple known cves. we've been delaying the upgrade but security is now mandating it. this has been going on for about a week now. i tried the usual troubleshooting steps. this is time-sensitive — please treat as high priority.
selected.resolution: Planned and executed upgrade to latest version during weekend maintenance window. All known CVEs addressed. Verified application functionality with automated test suite post-upgrade. No issues found. Updated CMDB with new version information.

selected.subject: Laptop keyboard keys not working
selected.description: hi it, several keys on my laptop keyboard stopped working — the e, r, and t keys specifically. makes it really hard to type. started after a small coffee spill last week that i cleaned up right away. restarting the application didn't fix it. would appreciate a fix when you get a chance — moderately impactful.
selected.resolution: Inspected keyboard — liquid damage to membrane under affected keys. Replaced keyboard assembly. All keys now functional. Recommended user keep liquids away from device.

selected.subject: Need contractor account
selected.description: good morning, we have a contractor starting a 6-month engagement with engineering. they need limited access — email, onelogin, and the engineering shared drive only. no vpn needed as they'll be onsite. i'm working remotely today if that matters. low priority — happy to wait until your schedule allows. thanks in advance.

selected.subject: Database backup failing every night
selected.description: our nightly database backup has been failing for the past 3 days. getting error 'insufficient space on backup destination.' nobody noticed until i checked this morning. i first saw this issue this morning. i asked a coworker and they don't have this problem. regards.
selected.resolution: Backup destination drive was full with old backups that weren't being rotated. Implemented retention policy to keep 30 days of backups. Cleared old files and re-ran backup successfully. Added monitoring alert for future failures.

selected.subject: Remove ex-employee from distribution lists
selected.description: hi, marta garcia left the company 2 weeks ago but they're still on several distribution lists. getting bounce-back errors every time we email the team list. happy to work around this short-term but it needs to be addressed. thanks in advance.
selected.resolution: Removed the former employee from all distribution lists (found membership in 7 lists). Cleaned up bounce-back queue. No more NDR errors on group emails.

selected.subject: DNS returning wrong IP for internal service
selected.description: when i nslookup our pfsense server it returns a different ip than what it should be. i think someone changed it but now the app is broken because it's pointing to the old decomissioned server. not super urgent but it's getting annoying.
selected.resolution: Found stale DNS record pointing to decommissioned host. Updated A record with correct IP address and flushed DNS caches on affected machines. Service now resolving correctly.

selected.subject: Third-party API dependency down
selected.description: good morning, our payment processing is failing because the third-party payment api is returning errors. customers can't complete purchases. vendor hasn't posted any status updates. i'm in west wing if someone needs to come look at it. i've rebooted twice, no change. please advise.

selected.subject: Self-service password reset not sending email
selected.description: tried to reset my password through the self-service portal but the reset email never arrives. checked spam folder too. waited 30 minutes, tried 3 times. this is only happening on my machine. this is affecting my productivity but not a total blocker. regards.

selected.subject: Backup taking too long — overlaps with business hours
selected.description: the full database backup now takes 6 hours and is still running when people start work at 8am. it slows everything down. used to finish by 5am. i'm on a tight deadline so this is really blocking me. i cleared my browser cache but it didn't help.

selected.subject: Second monitor keeps going to sleep
selected.description: my second monitor randomly goes black every 20-30 minutes and i have to unplug and replug the cable to get it back. primary monitor stays on the whole time. all work has stopped. this needs to be fixed in the next hour. thanks.

selected.subject: Data classification help needed
selected.description: we're working with a new dataset in marketing and need help classifying it per our data handling policy. it contains customer names and email addresses but no financial data. i asked a coworker and they don't have this problem. thanks.
selected.resolution: Reviewed dataset contents against data classification policy. Classified as 'Internal - PII' level. Applied appropriate handling requirements: encrypted storage, access logging, no external sharing without DPA. Updated data inventory register.

selected.subject: Load balancer not distributing traffic evenly
selected.description: two of our four application servers are getting 80% of the traffic while the other two sit nearly idle. load balancer should be distributing evenly. i'm on a tight deadline so this is really blocking me. i cleared my browser cache but it didn't help. not blocking me completely but i'd like this fixed today if possible. please advise.
selected.resolution: Load balancer was using sticky sessions with an overly long persistence timeout (24 hours). Reduced session persistence to 15 minutes and changed algorithm from source-IP to round-robin with least-connections. Traffic now distributed evenly across all four servers.

selected.subject: Need additional Tableau licenses
selected.description: our team has grown and we need 10 more licenses for tableau. current allocation is fully used and new team members can't access the software. i'm on a tight deadline so this is really blocking me. not urgent. please address when convenient.
selected.resolution: Submitted purchase request for 10 additional licenses. Procurement approved. Licenses procured and added to the license pool. All new team members now have access.

selected.subject: Backup verification needed for compliance audit
selected.description: our compliance team needs verification that database backups are working and restorable. audit is next week. can we do a test restore? it's been like this since monday. i tried the usual troubleshooting steps. i have a client deliverable due in 2 hours and this is stopping me. thanks.
selected.resolution: Performed full test restore of production database to isolated environment. Verified data integrity with checksums and row counts matching production. Documented results with timestamps for compliance audit.

selected.subject: Meeting room double booked
selected.description: conference room east wing shows as available when i booked it, but when i went to use it someone else was already in there with their own booking. calendar system seems broken. other people on my team are seeing the same thing. happy to work around this short-term but it needs to be addressed. thanks in advance.

selected.subject: New employee needs account setup
selected.description: we have a new hire starting in procurement on monday — ivan müller. they need a full account setup: email, vpn, sailpoint access, and building badge. thank you.
selected.resolution: Created AD account, provisioned email and calendar, set up VPN access, granted SailPoint license, and submitted badge request to facilities. Welcome email with credentials sent to manager for distribution on start date.

selected.subject: USB ports not working on desktop
selected.description: hey team, none of the front usb ports on my desktop are working. can't plug in my usb drive or charge my phone. the back ports still work though. this is only happening on my machine. we have an sla breach in 30 minutes if this isn't resolved.
selected.resolution: Front panel USB header cable had come loose from the motherboard. Reseated the internal cable connection. All front USB ports now functional.

selected.subject: Production service completely down
selected.description: our customer-facing jenkins application is completely down. users getting 503 errors. multiple teams reporting issues. started about 15 minutes ago. i checked and my internet connection seems fine. we have an sla breach in 30 minutes if this isn't resolved. please advise.
selected.resolution: Root cause: expired TLS certificate on the load balancer. Renewed certificate and installed on all load balancer nodes. Service restored within 20 minutes of escalation. Implemented certificate expiry monitoring to alert 30 days before expiration.

selected.subject: New subdomain not resolving
selected.description: we set up a new internal service at reporting.internal.company.com but nobody can reach it. dns doesn't seem to know about it. the server is running and reachable by ip. i've already missed one meeting because of this. please help urgently. regards.
selected.resolution: DNS A record had not been added for the new subdomain. Created the record pointing to the correct IP, waited for propagation, and confirmed resolution from multiple clients.

selected.subject: Need laptop replacement — current one is 5 years old
selected.description: my laptop is really struggling with daily tasks. it's almost 5 years old and constantly freezing during video calls and when i have more than a few browser tabs open. manager approved a replacement. i first saw this issue this morning. restarting the application didn't fix it. happy to work around this short-term but it needs to be addressed. thanks.
selected.resolution: Processed hardware replacement request. Provisioned new MacBook Air M2, migrated user profile and data from old machine. Old laptop wiped and sent to asset recovery. New laptop deployed and verified with user.

selected.subject: Can't see shared calendar
selected.description: my manager shared their calendar with me last week but i still can't see it in outlook. they confirmed they shared it and i accepted the sharing invitation. whenever you get a chance — low priority for me. thank you.
selected.resolution: Calendar permissions were granted but Outlook wasn't showing the shared calendar in the navigation pane. Manually added the shared calendar via Open Calendar > From Address Book. Calendar now visible with correct permissions.

selected.subject: Need to revoke database access for former team member
selected.description: hello, marcus santos transferred out of the analytics team. please remove their access to the data warehouse. they should no longer have direct database access. low priority — happy to wait until your schedule allows.
selected.resolution: Revoked all database permissions and removed user from analytics DB access group. Dropped their individual database login. Verified no active sessions remain. Documented access change in audit log.

selected.subject: VPN extremely slow
selected.description: hi it, connected to vpn but everything is incredibly slow. internal apps take 30+ seconds to load. speed test outside vpn shows 200mbps but on vpn it drops to about 2mbps. i checked and my internet connection seems fine. would appreciate a fix when you get a chance — moderately impactful. let me know if you need more info.
selected.resolution: Rerouted user to nearest VPN gateway (was connecting to wrong region). Latency dropped from 280ms to 35ms. Also cleared stale DNS cache entries that were causing additional delays.

selected.subject: Internet extremely slow for entire floor
selected.description: the whole 3rd floor is experiencing very slow internet. downloads are crawling, video calls keep freezing. started around 10am today. we've got about 40 people affected. this is only happening on my machine. i tried the usual troubleshooting steps. not urgent. please address when convenient. appreciate the help.
selected.resolution: Identified a failing switch on the 3rd floor causing packet loss and retransmissions. Replaced the switch and verified throughput returned to normal across all ports.

selected.subject: Need to reset password for shared account
selected.description: the shared account for the research reception desk needs a password reset. no one remembers the current password and we have a new receptionist starting today. i've rebooted twice, no change. low priority — happy to wait until your schedule allows. please advise.
selected.resolution: Reset shared account password and communicated new credentials securely to department manager. Also enabled shared mailbox access to reduce reliance on shared login credentials.

selected.subject: USB ports not working on desktop
selected.description: none of the front usb ports on my desktop are working. can't plug in my usb drive or charge my phone. the back ports still work though. production is down. all users affected. needs immediate escalation.
selected.resolution: Front panel USB header cable had come loose from the motherboard. Reseated the internal cable connection. All front USB ports now functional.

selected.subject: VM not responding — can't SSH/RDP
selected.description: production vm prod-web-03 is not responding to ssh connections. also can't ping it. the services it hosts are down. need urgent help. i'm working remotely today if that matters.
selected.resolution: VM had run out of disk space causing the OS to hang. Connected via hypervisor console, cleared log files consuming 95% of disk, and restarted services. Added disk space monitoring alert to prevent recurrence.

selected.subject: Need to update all machines before compliance deadline
selected.description: security audit requires all workstations to be on the latest os patch by end of month. we have about 50 machines in executive that still need the update. i checked and my internet connection seems fine.

selected.subject: Software reverted to trial mode
selected.description: my microsoft 365 suddenly reverted to trial mode and says i have 14 days left. i've been using the full version for over a year. all my premium features are locked. i'm working remotely today if that matters. production is down. all users affected. needs immediate escalation.
selected.resolution: License file was corrupted during a disk error. Restored license file from backup and re-validated with the license server. Full features restored.

selected.subject: New phone — need to transfer MFA
selected.description: hey team, got a new phone and need to transfer my mfa authenticator to it. old phone has been wiped already so i can't scan the qr code from the old app. it was working fine until last friday. no rush on this — just flagging it when you have time. cheers.
selected.resolution: Reset MFA enrollment for user's account. Generated new QR code and helped user set up authenticator on new phone. Verified 3 consecutive codes worked correctly.

selected.subject: New software conflicts with existing tool
selected.description: after installing sap erp, our existing crm tool started crashing. they seem to conflict somehow. i need both applications for my work. i noticed this after the last update. i asked a coworker and they don't have this problem. thanks.
selected.resolution: Both applications were competing for the same local port (8080). Reconfigured SAP ERP to use port 8180 instead. Both applications now run simultaneously without conflicts.

selected.subject: Need read access to production database
selected.description: i need read-only access to the production mongodb database for analytics work. my manager michael white has approved. i only need select permissions on the reporting schema. i tried logging out and back in. this is causing significant disruption to my team's work today. appreciate the help.
selected.resolution: Created database login with read-only role on reporting schema only. No access to PII tables per data classification policy. Tested access — user can run queries against approved tables.

selected.subject: Firewall blocking legitimate traffic
selected.description: hi it, since the firewall update last night, our ci/cd pipeline is broken. jenkins can't reach our artifact repository. getting connection timeouts on port 8081. it was working fine until last friday. cheers.

selected.subject: NULL values in required fields
selected.description: hey, found a bunch of null values in fields that should be mandatory — like order amount and customer name. about 500 records affected. data was loaded by the automated process. i tried the usual troubleshooting steps. this is completely blocking production — we are losing revenue every minute. please advise.
selected.resolution: Input validation was missing in the data pipeline for these fields. Added NOT NULL constraints to the database columns and added validation checks in the ETL pipeline with proper error handling. Manually fixed the 500 affected records from source data.

selected.subject: Monitor showing wrong resolution
selected.description: hey team, my monitor is stuck at 1024x768 and i can't change it to the native 2560x1440. the resolution dropdown doesn't show any higher options. just got this monitor today. i'm on a tight deadline so this is really blocking me. restarting the application didn't fix it. appreciate the help.
selected.resolution: Installed correct monitor driver and updated GPU driver. Native resolution now available in display settings. Set to 2560x1440 at 60Hz as recommended.

selected.subject: Calendar invites not being received
selected.description: people tell me they've sent me meeting invites but they never show up in my calendar or inbox. checked junk folder too — nothing. i've missed 3 meetings this week because of this. it's been like this since monday. would appreciate a fix when you get a chance — moderately impactful. regards.
